title: 大みそかとお正月(墨と朱)
subject_en: Japanese New Year's Eve and New Year motifs in a bold modern ink-brush style, black sumi strokes with vermilion red and gold accents, strong graphic shapes, each ONE motif centred in its cell, no people. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no calligraphy characters, no logos.
lead: 除夜の鐘・年越しそば・初日の出など大みそかからお正月の題材を、墨と朱のモダンなタッチで描いた12点です。年末年始のポスターやカードに使えます。
items: a large temple bell with a striking log, bold black ink strokes with a red sun behind
a bowl of soba noodles with chopsticks, steam drawn as ink swirls
a vermilion sun rising over mountains and a calm sea, bold ink waves
a pair of pine and bamboo kadomatsu, thick ink strokes with gold ties
a stacked kagami mochi with a bitter orange on top on a red-trimmed stand
a red daruma doll with bold black eyebrows and plain blank eyes
a crane in flight with long wings in sweeping black ink and a red crown
a hamaya arrow with feathers and a red-and-white bell ornament
a vermilion torii gate standing against dark pine silhouettes
Mount Fuji in black ink with a red sun, snow cap in cream
a three-tier lacquered osechi box seen from above with colourful dishes
a round wall clock with both hands at twelve, no numerals, surrounded by red ink splashes
